content: वत् {%a.%} .²1 An affix added to nouns to show ‘possession’; धनवत् possessed of wealth; रूपवत् beautiful; so भगवत्, भास्वत् <ab>&c.</ab>; (the words so formed being adjectives). .²2 Added to the base of the past passive participle वत् turns it into a past active participle; इत्युक्तवन्तं जनकात्मजायाम् <ls>R. 14. 43</ls>. .²3 Added to substantives in the sense of the locative; सूक्तवाके इति सूत्रयितव्ये सूक्तवाकवत् इति सूत्रितम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 2. 51</ls>. .²4 Added to substantives in the sense of अर्ह ‘worthy of’, ‘deserving’; ईहार्था सूक्तवाकार्हाः . अर्हे वतिर्द्रष्टव्यः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 2. 51</ls>. --{%ind.%} An affix added to nouns or adjectives to denote ‘likeness’ or ‘resemblance’ and may be translated by ‘like’, ‘as’; आत्मवत् सर्वभूतानि यः पश्यति स पण्डितः.
